rationale: ISO 32000-1:2008 Table 15 describes Prev as an indirect reference, whereas Adobe PDF Reference 1.7 Table 3.13 requires a direct integer. A direct byte offset allows a reader to locate the previous cross-reference section before resolving indirect references. This is an explicit implementation correction supported by the earlier Adobe reference, not a claim of an official ISO erratum. The original ISO source description and qualifier are preserved.
evidence_locator: Adobe PDF Reference 1.7, Table 3.13, printed page 97
